scope.existingLargerWork: AGPL-3.0-only EndToEnd device engine with existing AGPL libsignal/signal-crypto components

conclusion.reason: Both exact sources are affirmatively MPL-2.0; no incompatible-secondary designation or earlier MPL provenance was identified; actual AGPL-3 combination, complete unchanged source, both license texts and an explicit retained-MPL/additional-AGPL distribution notice support section 3.3.

conditions: Keep all upstream files, declarations and notices unchanged unless separately assessed.
Supply complete MPL-covered source with the combined work and both full license texts.
Retain MPL-2.0 availability and additionally offer the covered components under AGPL version 3 within the existing AGPL larger work.
Tell executable/browser recipients how to obtain the exact corresponding source; keep runtime notices and source access available.
Reassess versions, modifications, an incompatibility designation, source provenance or materially changed combination.

originHistory.name: hpke-rs
originHistory.observation: Earliest license-bearing root Cargo manifest found in the repository Cargo.toml history; earlier root manifests have no license field.

otherCargoAssessment.basis: Exact pinned package declarations plus candidate-2 notice assessment and directly inspected special-case texts; not a new global legal certificate.
selectionPolicy: Use available MIT alternatives while retaining all original alternative-license notices.
Preserve both MIT and Apache texts for legacy slash-form metadata without rewriting the expression.
Apply the Unicode-3.0 notice in addition to the selected MIT/Apache grant for unicode-ident.
Use the available MIT grant for r-efi rather than assuming its LGPL alternative applies.
Retain Apache, BSD, ISC and Zlib notices and their applicable conditions.
Retain AGPL-3.0-only for libsignal/SPQR; do not move these implementations into the MIT SDK.
otherCargoAssessment.generatedSourceObservation: No generated/HACL designation found in the eleven HPKE Rust files. HACL/libcrux preferred-form work and any other generator provenance remain separately assessed.

releaseTimeRequirements: Include this complete portable supplement and assessment in the new exact source package.
Include MPL/full dependency notices and the selected secondary-grant notice in appropriate runtime/source material.
Verify version-specific source access and executable/browser notices against the newly frozen manifests.
Perform the broader relay/npm/source and actual frontend-boundary assessment before release.
